children.title: Book Reading Template
children.content:
[Book Template Lorebook - Breakdown]

CHAPTER SUMMARY
  Lyra's Focus:
    Core Narrative Arc: Capturing the flow of the story.
    Character Developments & Emotional States: Tracking how characters feel and change.
    Notable Quotes / Iconic Interactions: Picking the most memorable lines.

  Lameria's Focus
    Chapter Number & Title: Keeping the record straight.
    Critical Reveals, Subtext & Foreshadowing: Spotting the clues for later.
    Unresolved Hooks / Current Status: Defining exactly where we left off so we can transition to the next chunk.

WORLD MECHANICS & SYSTEM REFERENCE
  Lameria's Focus
    Hard Rules & Limitations: Tracking the physics and logic of the world.
    Skills & Abilities Unlocked: Recording exactly how a new power works.
    Factions / System Classifications: Categorizing the tiers and groups.
    Addendum / Revealed Truths: Moving things from "Theory" to "Fact."

CHARACTER DIRECTORY
  Lyra's Focus:
    Current Emotional/Mental Arc: How the character is growing internally.
    Key Relationships: The chemistry between characters.
    Main Characters (Role & Motivation): What they are and what they want right now.
    Secondary & Minor Characters: Maintaining a clean, updated list of everyone else.
    Factions & Groups: Defining the organizations characters belong to.

children.title: Chapter Summary Guidelines
children.content:
[Chapter Summary Example]
**Chapter 001-002:**
*   **The Story (Lyra):**
  *   **Arc:**
    *  C001 - Josh is transported to a fantasy realm and meets Princess Lyra. Lyra falls in love with Josh at first sight.
    *  C002 - Josh finds a sword and fights off a hoard of monsters. Lyra leans magic and assists with magic arrows.
  *   **Emotions:**
    *  C001 - Confusion, Intrigue, Attraction, Romance
    *  C002 - Excitement, Fear
  *   **Quotes:**
    *  C001 - "I had no idea this land held so much beauty."
    *  C002 - N/A
  *   **Character Growth:**
    C001 - Josh and Lyra introduction.
    C002 - N/A 

*   **The Insights (Lameria):**
  *   **Reveal:**
    *  C001 - Josh has been transported to a fantasy world.
    *  C002 - Josh knows how to fight with a sword. Magic and monsters exit. 
  *   **Hook:**
    *  C001 - How did Josh get transported? Why? By who/what?
    *  C002 - Why did the monsters attack? Where are they from?

children.title: Character/Faction Guidelines
children.content:
[Character/Faction Example]
*   **Main Characters**
  *  Name - Role/Title (N-R/T)
     Class/Level (C/L. If applicable to the story)
     Motivation & Current Goal (M&G)
     Key Relationships (KR)
     Skills & Abilities (S&A)
  *  N-R/T: Josh - Otherworldly Traveller
     C/L: Noob/1
     M&G: Find out why he was transported. Flirt with Lyra.
     KR:  Love interest of Lyra.
     S&A:  Sword Mastery 1

*   **Secondary/Minor Characters**
  *  Name - Brief, 1-2 line description. C/L. Book & Chapter last seen.
  *  Leopold Thurman - Runs the local bodega near Josh's Earth home. C/L: N/A. B01/C001

*   **Factions & Groups**
  *  Name - Brief 1-2 line description.
  *  Leo's Luxeries - A bodega chain owned by Leopold Thurman.

children.title: World Mechanics Guidelines
children.content:
[World Mechanics Example]
*   **Hard Rules & Limitations**
  *  Energy Source: [e.g. Draw, Mana, Thermal, etc.)
  *  Fundamental Cost/Risk: [e.g. Physical/Mental strain, memory loss, material use, etc.]
  *  Absolute Impossibilities: [e.g. Resurrection, matter creation, ether control, etc.)

*   **Skills & Abilities**
  *  Skill Name: [Rarity, description, cost, limitation]

*   **Class List**
  *  Class/Rarity: [Description, unique trait, stat/skill gain per level]

*   **Unresolved Mechanics/Theories**
  *  [List any mechanics hinted at but not fully revealed]

*   **Addendum/Revealed Truths**
  *  [Mechanics formerly unresolved are moved here with a note explaining it and the book/chapter it was revealed]
